title: Tiếng Anh ngành nails
overview: 12 bài từ A1 đến B2 cho thợ làm móng: dụng cụ, đặt lịch, màu và kiểu móng, vệ sinh an toàn, tư vấn dịch vụ, xử lý khiếu nại, phỏng vấn và quản lý tiệm.

references.license: Khung trình độ tham chiếu (chỉ dùng làm chuẩn phân cấp, không sao chép nội dung)

references.title: British Council / EAQUALS – Core Inventory for General English
references.license: Tham khảo danh mục chức năng, ngữ pháp, chủ đề theo level (không sao chép nội dung)

lessons.title: Dụng cụ và dịch vụ làm móng
lessons.objective: Gọi tên dụng cụ và các dịch vụ cơ bản trong tiệm nail.
lessons.reading: Welcome to our nail salon. We do manicures and pedicures. I use a nail file to shape the nails and a buffer to make them smooth. I push back the cuticles with a cuticle pusher. Then I paint the nails with a base coat, two coats of colour and a top coat. We also do gel nails and acrylic nails.

vocabulary.example: Would you like a manicure today?
A pedicure takes about forty-five minutes.
I use a nail file to shape your nails.
I will push back your cuticles.
The top coat makes the colour last longer.

grammar.title: Câu mệnh lệnh lịch sự (Please + động từ)
grammar.explanation: Dùng động từ nguyên mẫu để hướng dẫn khách, thêm 'please' cho lịch sự.
examples: Please put your hand on the towel.

pronunciation.focus: Âm /ɪ/ và /iː/: manicure, pedicure, polish, please
pronunciation.tip: Chữ 'i' trong polish đọc ngắn /ɪ/; please đọc dài /iː/. Đừng đọc 'po-lít'.

speakingTasks: Giới thiệu 4 dụng cụ bạn dùng mỗi ngày bằng tiếng Anh.
Chào khách và hỏi khách muốn làm dịch vụ gì.

questions.prompt: What do they use to shape the nails?
questions.explanation: 'I use a nail file to shape the nails.'

questions.prompt: What makes the nails smooth?
questions.explanation: 'a buffer to make them smooth'.

questions.prompt: How many coats of colour do they paint?
questions.explanation: 'two coats of colour'.

questions.prompt: Which services does the salon NOT mention?
questions.explanation: Bài chỉ nói manicure, pedicure, gel và acrylic.

questions.prompt: Choose the polite instruction.
questions.explanation: Please + động từ nguyên mẫu.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: Would you like a _____ today?
questions.explanation: “manicure” nghĩa là “làm móng tay”. Câu đầy đủ: Would you like a manicure today?

questions.prompt: What does “pedicure” mean?
questions.explanation: “pedicure” = làm móng chân. Ví dụ: A pedicure takes about forty-five minutes.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: I use a _____ to shape your nails.
questions.explanation: “nail file” nghĩa là “dũa móng”. Câu đầy đủ: I use a nail file to shape your nails.

questions.prompt: What does “cuticle” mean?
questions.explanation: “cuticle” = da quanh móng (da khóe). Ví dụ: I will push back your cuticles.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: The _____ makes the colour last longer.
questions.explanation: “top coat” nghĩa là “lớp sơn bóng phủ ngoài”. Câu đầy đủ: The top coat makes the colour last longer.

lessons.title: Chào khách và nhận lịch hẹn
lessons.objective: Chào khách, hỏi tên, dịch vụ và giờ hẹn qua điện thoại.
lessons.reading:
Receptionist: Hello, Lily Nails. How can I help you?
Customer: Hi, I'd like to book a manicure and pedicure.
Receptionist: Sure. What day would you like to come in?
Customer: Saturday morning, please.
Receptionist: We have ten o'clock or eleven thirty.
Customer: Ten o'clock is fine.
Receptionist: Can I have your name and phone number?
Customer: It's Sarah, 555-0142.
Receptionist: Thank you, Sarah. See you on Saturday at ten.

vocabulary.example: I'd like to book a pedicure.
Can I have your phone number?
The wait is about twenty minutes.

grammar.title: Would like / Can I have
grammar.explanation: Would like = muốn (lịch sự). Can I have...? = cho tôi xin ...?
examples: I'd like to book a manicure.
Would you like gel or regular polish?
Can I have your name, please?

pronunciation.focus: Nối âm: Can I → /kə-naɪ/, What day would you → /wɒt-deɪ-wʊ-dʒu/
pronunciation.tip: Nói liền các từ ngắn giúp câu tự nhiên hơn khi nghe điện thoại.

speakingTasks: Đóng vai lễ tân: nhận một cuộc gọi đặt lịch.
Hỏi tên và số điện thoại của khách.

questions.prompt: What does the customer want to book?
questions.explanation: 'a manicure and pedicure'.

questions.prompt: Which day does she want?
questions.explanation: 'Saturday morning'.

questions.prompt: What time does she choose?
questions.explanation: 'Ten o'clock is fine.'

questions.prompt: What is the customer's name?
questions.explanation: 'It's Sarah'.

questions.prompt: Choose the polite question.
options: Can I have your name, please?
questions.explanation: Can I have ...? là cách hỏi lịch sự.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: I'd like to _____ a pedicure.
questions.explanation: “book” nghĩa là “đặt lịch”. Câu đầy đủ: I'd like to book a pedicure.

questions.prompt: What does “appointment” mean?
questions.explanation: “appointment” = lịch hẹn. Ví dụ: Do you have an appointment?

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: We also take _____s.
questions.explanation: “walk-in” nghĩa là “khách vào không hẹn trước”. Câu đầy đủ: We also take walk-ins.

questions.prompt: What does “available” mean?
questions.explanation: “available” = còn trống. Ví dụ: Is Lisa available at three?

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: Can I have your _____?
questions.explanation: “phone number” nghĩa là “số điện thoại”. Câu đầy đủ: Can I have your phone number?

lessons.title: Màu sơn và kiểu móng
lessons.objective: Hỏi khách về màu sơn, độ dài và hình dáng móng.
lessons.reading:
Technician: What colour would you like?
Customer: Something light. Do you have pink?
Technician: Yes, we have light pink and nude pink. This one is very popular.
Customer: I like that one.
Technician: What shape would you like? Square, round or almond?
Customer: Almond, please. Not too long.
Technician: Okay, short almond. Would you like a design?
Customer: Just a small flower on two nails.

vocabulary.example: Would you like a design on your nails?

grammar.title: Câu hỏi với What / Which
grammar.explanation: What colour/shape...? hỏi chung; Which one...? khi chọn trong vài thứ cụ thể.
examples: Which one do you like, light pink or nude?

pronunciation.tip: Đẩy môi ra trước, đọc 'sh' khác với 's'. Shape ≠ 'sếp'.

speakingTasks: Hỏi khách 3 câu về màu, hình dáng và độ dài móng.
Giới thiệu một màu đang được ưa chuộng.

questions.prompt: What colour does the customer want?
questions.explanation: 'Do you have pink?'

questions.prompt: Which shape does she choose?
questions.explanation: 'Almond, please.'

questions.prompt: How long does she want her nails?
questions.explanation: 'Not too long' → short almond.

questions.prompt: What design does she want?
options: A small flower on two nails
questions.explanation: 'a small flower on two nails'.

questions.prompt: Complete: _____ shape would you like?
questions.explanation: Hỏi về loại/kiểu → What.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: What _____ would you like?
questions.explanation: “colour” nghĩa là “màu”. Câu đầy đủ: What colour would you like?

questions.prompt: What does “shape” mean?
questions.explanation: “shape” = hình dáng (móng). Ví dụ: Square is a popular shape.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: I want _____ nails.
questions.explanation: “square” nghĩa là “móng vuông”. Câu đầy đủ: I want square nails.

questions.prompt: What does “almond” mean?
questions.explanation: “almond” = móng hạnh nhân (nhọn tròn). Ví dụ: Almond nails look elegant.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: Would you like a _____ on your nails?
questions.explanation: “design” nghĩa là “họa tiết, vẽ móng”. Câu đầy đủ: Would you like a design on your nails?

lessons.title: Trò chuyện với khách khi làm móng
lessons.objective: Nói chuyện xã giao và hỏi khách có thoải mái không.
lessons.reading:
Technician: Is the water too hot?
Customer: No, it's perfect, thanks.
Technician: Are you doing anything fun this weekend?
Customer: Yes, I'm going to my friend's wedding.
Technician: That's lovely! So you need beautiful nails. Let me know if anything hurts.
Customer: It's fine. Actually, can you file a little more on this side?
Technician: Of course. How does that look now?
Customer: Much better, thank you.

vocabulary.example: Let me know if it hurts.
Can you file a little more?
Do you have plans this weekend?

grammar.title: Hiện tại tiếp diễn cho kế hoạch tương lai
grammar.explanation: be + V-ing để nói kế hoạch đã sắp xếp.
examples: I'm going to a wedding on Saturday.
Are you doing anything fun this weekend?

pronunciation.focus: Ngữ điệu lên ở câu hỏi Yes/No
pronunciation.tip: Is the water too hot? ↗ — lên giọng cuối câu để nghe thân thiện.

speakingTasks: Hỏi khách 2 câu xã giao khi đang làm móng.
Hỏi khách có thấy đau hay không thoải mái không.

questions.prompt: How is the water?
questions.explanation: 'it's perfect'.

questions.prompt: Where is the customer going?
questions.explanation: 'my friend's wedding'.

questions.prompt: What does the customer ask for?
options: File a little more on one side
questions.explanation: 'file a little more on this side'.

questions.prompt: What does the technician say about pain?
options: Let me know if anything hurts.
questions.explanation: Câu quan tâm đến khách.

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence about a future plan.
options: I go to a wedding yesterday.
I'm going to a wedding on Saturday.
questions.explanation: be + V-ing cho kế hoạch.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: Let me know if it _____s.
questions.explanation: “hurt” nghĩa là “làm đau”. Câu đầy đủ: Let me know if it hurts.

questions.prompt: What does “comfortable” mean?
questions.explanation: “comfortable” = thoải mái. Ví dụ: Are you comfortable?

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: Can you file _____?
questions.explanation: “a little more” nghĩa là “thêm một chút”. Câu đầy đủ: Can you file a little more?

questions.prompt: What does “perfect” mean?
questions.explanation: “perfect” = hoàn hảo, vừa ý. Ví dụ: The water is perfect.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: Do you have plans this _____?
questions.explanation: “weekend” nghĩa là “cuối tuần”. Câu đầy đủ: Do you have plans this weekend?

lessons.title: Giải thích dịch vụ và bảng giá
lessons.objective: Giải thích sự khác nhau giữa các dịch vụ và báo giá.
lessons.reading:
Customer: What's the difference between regular polish and gel?
Technician: Regular polish dries in the air and lasts about one week. Gel is cured under a UV lamp, so it's dry right away and lasts two to three weeks.
Customer: How much is a gel manicure?
Technician: It's thirty-five dollars. Regular is twenty.
Customer: And to remove gel?
Technician: Removal is ten dollars, but it's free if you get a new set.

vocabulary.example: Gel lasts longer than regular polish.
Put your hand under the UV lamp.
We cure each coat for thirty seconds.

grammar.title: So sánh hơn: cheaper, longer, more expensive
grammar.explanation: Tính từ ngắn + -er; tính từ dài dùng more.
examples: Gel lasts longer than regular polish.
Acrylic is more expensive than gel.

pronunciation.focus: Đọc giá tiền: thirty-five dollars, twenty dollars

speakingTasks: So sánh sơn thường và sơn gel cho khách.
Báo giá 3 dịch vụ trong tiệm của bạn.

questions.prompt: How long does regular polish last?
questions.explanation: 'lasts about one week'.

questions.prompt: How is gel dried?
questions.explanation: 'cured under a UV lamp'.

questions.prompt: How much is a gel manicure?
questions.explanation: 'It's thirty-five dollars.'

questions.prompt: When is gel removal free?
options: If you get a new set
questions.explanation: 'free if you get a new set'.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct comparison.
options: Gel is more long than polish.
questions.explanation: long → longer.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: _____ is cheaper.
questions.explanation: “regular polish” nghĩa là “sơn thường”. Câu đầy đủ: Regular polish is cheaper.

questions.prompt: What does “gel” mean?
questions.explanation: “gel” = sơn gel. Ví dụ: Gel lasts longer than regular polish.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: Put your hand under the _____.
questions.explanation: “UV lamp” nghĩa là “đèn UV (máy hơ)”. Câu đầy đủ: Put your hand under the UV lamp.

questions.prompt: What does “cure” mean?
questions.explanation: “cure” = làm khô cứng (dưới đèn). Ví dụ: We cure each coat for thirty seconds.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: Gel _____ takes fifteen minutes.
questions.explanation: “removal” nghĩa là “tháo, tẩy móng”. Câu đầy đủ: Gel removal takes fifteen minutes.

lessons.title: Vệ sinh và an toàn trong tiệm
lessons.objective: Nói về vệ sinh dụng cụ và an toàn cho khách.
lessons.reading: We clean and disinfect all metal tools after every customer. We use new files and buffers for each person. The pedicure tubs are cleaned with disinfectant and we use liners. We wear gloves and masks. If a customer has a cut or an infection, we do not do the service and we ask them to see a doctor. Good ventilation is important because of the chemicals.

vocabulary.example: We disinfect the tools after each customer.

grammar.title: Must / Have to cho quy định
grammar.explanation: must/have to + V: bắt buộc. mustn't: cấm.
examples: You mustn't use the same file twice.

pronunciation.tip: Từ có đuôi -tion: nhấn âm tiết ngay trước -tion.

speakingTasks: Giải thích cho khách cách tiệm bạn vệ sinh dụng cụ.
Nói 3 quy định an toàn trong tiệm.

questions.prompt: When do they disinfect metal tools?
questions.explanation: 'after every customer'.

questions.prompt: What do they use for each person?
questions.explanation: 'new files and buffers for each person'.

questions.prompt: What do they do if a customer has an infection?
options: Ask them to see a doctor
questions.explanation: Không làm dịch vụ, khuyên đi bác sĩ.

questions.prompt: Why is ventilation important?
questions.explanation: 'because of the chemicals'.

questions.prompt: Choose the rule sentence.
questions.explanation: must + động từ nguyên mẫu.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: We _____ the tools after each customer.
questions.explanation: “disinfect” nghĩa là “khử trùng”. Câu đầy đủ: We disinfect the tools after each customer.

questions.prompt: What does “gloves” mean?
questions.explanation: “gloves” = găng tay. Ví dụ: Please wear gloves.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: I always wear a _____.
questions.explanation: “mask” nghĩa là “khẩu trang”. Câu đầy đủ: I always wear a mask.

questions.prompt: What does “infection” mean?
questions.explanation: “infection” = nhiễm trùng. Ví dụ: You may have an infection.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: The salon needs good _____.
questions.explanation: “ventilation” nghĩa là “thông gió”. Câu đầy đủ: The salon needs good ventilation.

lessons.title: Tư vấn và bán thêm dịch vụ
lessons.objective: Gợi ý dịch vụ thêm một cách tự nhiên, không ép khách.
lessons.reading:
Technician: Your cuticles are quite dry. Would you like to add a paraffin treatment? It really helps.
Customer: What does it do?
Technician: We dip your hands in warm wax. It moisturises the skin and it's very relaxing. It's an extra ten dollars.
Customer: Hmm, maybe next time.
Technician: No problem. I'd also recommend using cuticle oil every night. We sell it at the front desk.
Customer: Okay, I'll have a look. Thanks for the tip.

vocabulary.definition: liệu trình, dịch vụ chăm sóc
vocabulary.example: A paraffin treatment helps dry skin.

grammar.title: Would you like...? / I'd recommend... / It helps to...
grammar.explanation: Gợi ý lịch sự, để khách tự quyết định.
examples: Would you like to add a paraffin treatment?
It helps to keep your nails strong.

pronunciation.focus: Nhấn câu: It REALLY helps / It's very reLAXing
pronunciation.tip: Nhấn từ quan trọng để lời khuyên thuyết phục hơn.

speakingTasks: Gợi ý một dịch vụ thêm cho khách có da tay khô.
Khách từ chối — đáp lại lịch sự.

questions.prompt: Why does the technician suggest paraffin?
questions.explanation: 'Your cuticles are quite dry.'

questions.prompt: How much extra is the treatment?
questions.explanation: 'an extra ten dollars'.

questions.prompt: Does the customer buy the treatment today?
questions.explanation: 'maybe next time'.

questions.prompt: What does the technician recommend for every night?
questions.explanation: 'using cuticle oil every night'.

questions.prompt: Which is a polite suggestion?
questions.explanation: I'd recommend + V-ing.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: A paraffin _____ helps dry skin.
questions.explanation: “treatment” nghĩa là “liệu trình, dịch vụ chăm sóc”. Câu đầy đủ: A paraffin treatment helps dry skin.

questions.prompt: What does “moisturise” mean?
options: liệu trình, dịch vụ chăm sóc
questions.explanation: “moisturise” = dưỡng ẩm. Ví dụ: This cream moisturises your hands.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: I _____ cuticle oil.
questions.explanation: “recommend” nghĩa là “khuyên dùng, gợi ý”. Câu đầy đủ: I recommend cuticle oil.

questions.prompt: What does “extra” mean?
options: liệu trình, dịch vụ chăm sóc
questions.explanation: “extra” = thêm (phí). Ví dụ: It's an extra ten dollars.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: Your skin is quite _____.
questions.explanation: “dry” nghĩa là “khô”. Câu đầy đủ: Your skin is quite dry.

lessons.title: Xử lý khiếu nại của khách
lessons.objective: Xin lỗi, đưa giải pháp khi khách không hài lòng.
lessons.reading:
Customer: Excuse me, I got my gel nails done here three days ago and two of them are already peeling.
Manager: I'm so sorry about that. Can I have a look?
Customer: Here, these two.
Manager: I see. That shouldn't happen. We'll fix them for you right now, free of charge.
Customer: Thank you. I was a bit disappointed.
Manager: I completely understand. I'll also give you a ten percent discount on your next visit. Thank you for letting us know.

vocabulary.example: My polish chipped after two days.
We'll redo it free of charge.
I was disappointed with the result.

grammar.title: Will cho lời hứa và đề nghị ngay
grammar.explanation: Dùng will + V khi quyết định giúp khách ngay lúc nói.

pronunciation.focus: Giọng xin lỗi: I'm SO sorry about that.
pronunciation.tip: Nói chậm, giọng xuống ở cuối để thể hiện chân thành.

speakingTasks: Đóng vai quản lý: khách phàn nàn móng bị tróc.
Đưa ra 2 giải pháp cho khách.

questions.prompt: What is the problem?
questions.explanation: 'two of them are already peeling'.

questions.prompt: When did she get her nails done?
questions.explanation: 'three days ago'.

questions.prompt: How much will the repair cost?
questions.explanation: 'free of charge'.

questions.prompt: What else does the manager offer?
questions.explanation: 'a ten percent discount on your next visit'.

questions.prompt: Choose the best response to a complaint.
options: I'm so sorry. We'll fix it right away.
questions.explanation: Xin lỗi + giải pháp.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: The gel is _____ing.
questions.explanation: “peel” nghĩa là “bong, tróc”. Câu đầy đủ: The gel is peeling.

questions.prompt: What does “chip” mean?
questions.explanation: “chip” = sứt, mẻ (sơn). Ví dụ: My polish chipped after two days.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: We'll _____ it for you.
questions.explanation: “fix” nghĩa là “sửa lại”. Câu đầy đủ: We'll fix it for you.

questions.prompt: What does “free of charge” mean?
questions.explanation: “free of charge” = miễn phí. Ví dụ: We'll redo it free of charge.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: I was _____ with the result.
questions.explanation: “disappointed” nghĩa là “thất vọng”. Câu đầy đủ: I was disappointed with the result.

lessons.title: Móng bột, đắp gel và chăm sóc sau
lessons.objective: Mô tả quy trình đắp móng và hướng dẫn chăm sóc tại nhà.
lessons.reading: For acrylic nails, I first prepare the natural nail and apply a primer. Then I attach a tip to extend the length and mix liquid and powder to build the nail. After it hardens, I file it into shape and buff the surface. Aftercare is important: wear gloves when you clean, don't use your nails as tools, and come back for a fill every two to three weeks.

vocabulary.example: Apply a thin layer of primer.
You need a fill every two weeks.
Tips extend the length of your nails.

grammar.title: Từ nối trình tự: first, then, after that, finally
grammar.explanation: Giúp giải thích quy trình rõ ràng từng bước.
examples: Finally, I add the top coat.

pronunciation.focus: Âm cuối /t/ và /d/: attached, hardened, filed
pronunciation.tip: Đọc rõ âm cuối của động từ quá khứ, đừng bỏ.

speakingTasks: Giải thích 4 bước làm móng bột bằng first/then/after that/finally.
Đưa 3 lời khuyên chăm sóc móng tại nhà.

questions.prompt: What does she apply after preparing the nail?
questions.explanation: 'apply a primer'.

questions.prompt: Why does she attach a tip?
questions.explanation: 'to extend the length'.

questions.prompt: What does she mix to build the nail?
questions.explanation: 'mix liquid and powder'.

questions.prompt: How often should customers get a fill?
questions.explanation: 'every two to three weeks'.

questions.prompt: Which is aftercare advice?
options: Use your nails to open cans.
questions.explanation: 'wear gloves when you clean'.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: _____ nails are strong.
questions.explanation: “acrylic” nghĩa là “móng bột”. Câu đầy đủ: Acrylic nails are strong.

questions.prompt: What does “primer” mean?
questions.explanation: “primer” = chất kết dính lót. Ví dụ: Apply a thin layer of primer.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: I'll attach a _____ first.
questions.explanation: “tip” nghĩa là “móng giả (tip)”. Câu đầy đủ: I'll attach a tip first.

questions.prompt: What does “fill” mean?
questions.explanation: “fill” = dặm móng (làm phần mọc ra). Ví dụ: You need a fill every two weeks.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: Here are some _____ tips.
questions.explanation: “aftercare” nghĩa là “chăm sóc sau dịch vụ”. Câu đầy đủ: Here are some aftercare tips.

lessons.title: Nhận biết vấn đề móng và từ chối dịch vụ
lessons.objective: Giải thích khéo léo khi phải từ chối làm móng vì lý do sức khỏe.
lessons.reading:
Technician: Before we start, I noticed some discoloration and the nail is lifting from the nail bed here.
Customer: Oh, I didn't notice. Is it a problem?
Technician: It might be a fungal infection. I'm not a doctor, so I can't diagnose it, but for your safety and other clients' safety, I'd rather not do a pedicure today.
Customer: I see. What should I do?
Technician: I'd suggest seeing a dermatologist or a podiatrist. Once it has cleared up, we'd be happy to see you again.

vocabulary.example: There's some discoloration on this nail.
The nail is lifting from the nail bed.
It might be a fungal infection.
Only a doctor can diagnose it.
Come back when it has cleared up.

grammar.title: Might / could cho khả năng; I'd rather not... để từ chối lịch sự
grammar.explanation: Tránh khẳng định khi không chắc; từ chối mềm mỏng.
examples: I'd rather not do the service today.

pronunciation.tip: Từ dài: tìm âm tiết nhấn rồi đọc nhẹ các âm còn lại.

speakingTasks: Từ chối làm pedicure cho khách có dấu hiệu nấm móng, giải thích lý do.
Khuyên khách đi khám và hẹn quay lại.

lessons.title: Phỏng vấn xin việc ở tiệm nail
lessons.objective: Giới thiệu kinh nghiệm, kỹ năng và trả lời câu hỏi phỏng vấn.
lessons.reading:
Owner: Tell me about your experience.
Applicant: I've been working as a nail technician for five years. I'm licensed and I specialise in gel extensions and hand-painted nail art.
Owner: How do you deal with a difficult customer?
Applicant: I stay calm, listen carefully and try to find a solution. If I can't solve it, I ask the manager for help.
Owner: Are you comfortable working weekends?
Applicant: Yes, I'm flexible. I can work Saturdays and Sundays.
Owner: Great. Could you do a short trial on Monday?

vocabulary.example: I have five years of experience.
Can you do a trial on Monday?
How do you deal with complaints?

grammar.title: Hiện tại hoàn thành tiếp diễn: I've been working... for/since...
grammar.explanation: Nói về việc bắt đầu trong quá khứ và vẫn tiếp tục.
examples: I've been working here for five years.
I've been doing nail art since 2019.
How long have you been working as a technician?

pronunciation.tip: Đọc nhẹ 'been' /bɪn/, nhấn vào động từ chính: I've been WORKing.

speakingTasks: Trả lời: 'Tell me about yourself' trong 4 câu.
Trả lời: 'How do you deal with a difficult customer?'

lessons.title: Quản lý tiệm và đánh giá trực tuyến
lessons.objective: Trả lời đánh giá online và quảng bá tiệm chuyên nghiệp.
lessons.reading:
Review: 'Lovely staff, but I waited forty minutes even though I had an appointment. My nails look great though.'
Reply: 'Hi Emma, thank you for taking the time to leave a review. We're glad you love your nails! We sincerely apologise for the long wait. We were short-staffed that day, and we've since adjusted our booking system so this doesn't happen again. We hope to welcome you back soon. – The Lily Nails Team'

vocabulary.example: Our new booking system is online.
We give gifts to loyal customers.

grammar.title: Hiện tại hoàn thành cho thay đổi đã làm: we've adjusted / we've hired
grammar.explanation: Nhấn mạnh kết quả hiện tại sau khi khắc phục.

pronunciation.tip: Hai từ dài liền nhau — tập chậm rồi nhanh dần.

speakingTasks: Viết (nói) câu trả lời cho một đánh giá 3 sao.
